profile.headline: Website Content Specialist | CMS & Accessibility | HubSpot, AEM, WordPress | HTML/CSS | QA | Mission-Driven Projects
profile.summary:
I’m a Website Content Specialist with 10+ years of experience in CMS management, accessibility QA, and digital content strategy. I’ve built responsive, mission-driven websites using HubSpot, AEM, and WordPress—most notably launching GardenForWildlife.com, a zip code–driven eCommerce platform for native plants.

My strengths lie in HTML/CSS/JS, stakeholder coordination, HubL module customization, and ensuring accessible, brand-aligned web content. I'm passionate about meaningful work and thrive in collaborative, creative environments where quality and purpose matter.

positions.title: Freelance
positions.description:
Quickly met client Graphic Design needs using Photoshop, Illustrator, and Flash
Created flash based artwork for banner ads.
Assisted porting content from an old site to a new site, using Common Spot CMS.
Updated and maintained entire site using Ektron CMS.
Created Multiple Micro-Sites under main design umbrella.
Designed HTML newsletter emails.
Developed database implementation for online store.
Optimized web images for download efficiency.
Created and implemented an online blog based on design comps using css, html, php, js.
Worked with other departments to meet their website needs quickly and efficiently.
Used web based tools to track website statistics.    
Some clients include CoStar Group, AARP, Rosenthal Partners, The Endocrine Society, International Association of Fire Chiefs (IAFC)

positions.title: Freelance Web Graphic Designer
positions.description: Skills: Passionate about Work · CMS Management, HubSpot CMS & HubL, Accessibility QA (508/WCAG), HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Content Strategy, Landing Page Optimization, SEO for Web Content, Website QA Testing, Stakeholder Communication · Technical Design · Communication · Web Performance

positions.title: Web & Graphic Production & Development Specialist
positions.description:
Designed and implemented web based phone books using a combination of Javascript, Flash (ActionScript), Html, CSS, SQL and XML. 
Worked as liaison between production and development team.
Worked as a member of a design team.
Created graphical User Interface elements, web images, icons.
Specialized in creative solutions for new applications. 
Designed clean, effective web pages optimizing web images for download efficiency. 
Responded to a variety of web and graphics related requests across departments. 
Fulfilled several project requests simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines. 
Implemented Search Engine Optimization and 508 compliance.

positions.title: Graphic Production Specialist
positions.description: Skills: Communication

positions.title: Web Design
positions.description:
Coordinated workflow for projects requiring graphic design, pre-press work and digital output to ensure that deadlines were met
Regularly interacted with customers in person and over the telephone to discuss design requirements and answer questions
Designed web sites consisting of approximately 20 pages and over 200 images.
Designed the site architecture, prepared images, and authored the site in Dreamweaver and HTML.

positions.title: Freelance Designer - Decorative Artist / Faux Finisher
positions.description:
Clients include the Department of Justice and the Kennedy Center, Club Hollywood in Annapolis, and Master Craft Interiors in Fairfax.
Mentored junior artists in design, preparation, and execution.
Presented workshops for Theatrical Faux Finishing.
Estimated schedule and resource requirements based on delivered designs.
Initiated contact with new clients.
Designed letterhead, business cards, newsletters, and other promotional materials for a variety of customers
Interacted with customer service, production and sales departments during the course of project development
